biotools.summary: Molchanica is a molecule visualization, editing, and computation tool.  It operates with the focus on visualizing molecules over time and space. Any molecule you open or build can move using molecular dynamics. It integrates with machine-learning tools for protein engineering, including RFDiffusion3, OpenFold3, Boltz-2, OpenDDE, ProteinMPNN, and Chai-1. It integrates quantum chemistry tools to compute energy, geometry, electron density, and more.
biotools.name: Molchanica
